title: The bacteria that make cheese taste so good may also benefit your gut

title: Webb’s mysterious little red dots may be hiding entire galaxies

By studying a spiral galaxy nicknamed the “Saguaro,” researchers found a compact, bright red center that closely resembles these distant objects—but with something Webb usually can’t see around them: a full galaxy. When the team simulated what the Saguaro would look like much farther away, its spiral structure essentially vanished, leaving only the bright red core.

title: Tiny 1.7-billion-year-old fossils could reveal how complex life began

title: Physicists discover a hidden gluon structure inside protons that could rewrite textbooks

The finding challenges a decades-old textbook picture and could deepen our understanding of why protons—and ultimately matter itself—remain stable.

title: Scientists reveal why walking gets so much harder with age

This leads to shorter strides, slower walking, and faster fatigue. Exercises targeting balance, coordination, and lower-leg strength could help preserve mobility.
